description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordStrengthService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides functionalities related to password policy enforcement, strength validation, and reset request management, including password complexity checks, generating reset codes, and handling password reset requests.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class providing password strength validation, enforcement, and reset request functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Retrieves the data access object responsible for enforcement password operations.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Gets the minimum password length configuration.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum password length configuration.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of lowercase letters required in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of uppercase letters required in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of numeric characters required in the password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of special characters required.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Indicates if spaces are allowed in passwords.

methods.name: getDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Retrieves the default password strength setting.

methods.name: checkMinPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMaxPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: checkMinLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of lowercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of uppercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinNumbersInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of digits.

methods.name: checkMinSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of special characters.

methods.name: checkSpacesInPassword
methods.description: Checks if spaces are present when they are not allowed.

methods.name: checkRequiredDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Checks if the password strength meets the default policy requirement.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Evaluates the password against the defined policies and returns messages for violations.

methods.name: isValidPassword
methods.description: Validates if the password complies with all strength policies.

methods.name: generateEnforcePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a random code for password reset enforcement.

methods.name: logPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Creates and logs a password reset request, returning the reset code.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the reset code URL, checking expiration and usage.

methods.name: isResetCodeTimeOut
methods.description: Checks if the reset code has timed out based on request time.

methods.name: getUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a given reset code.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates user object, ensuring user is active and valid.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Saves a new enforced password for the user after transaction management.
